extracted.intended_audience: general public and readers interested in heart and brain health (patients, caregivers, health-interested lay audience)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance / expectations implied by the American Heart Association News site for producing or republishing consumer-facing health news stories about heart and brain health, including editorial review and availability in Spanish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging, science-based people-focused stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Look no further for engaging and science-based stories about people and your heart and brain health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site positions its content as "engaging and science-based" and focused on personal stories about heart and brain health; examples on the page are human-interest narratives (e.g., patients, survivors, clinicians) combined with health/science topics. The page lists categories and tags (Stories From the Heart, Women’s Health, High Blood Pressure, etc.) indicating topic-focus and audience orientation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific and statistical review by AHA advisors
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories for the American Heart Association website are produced by our content team and all stories receive statistical- and science-based reviewed by the American Heart Association's team of science and medicine advisors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural/quality requirement: every story is subject to review for scientific and statistical accuracy by AHA science and medicine advisors. The page does not provide the detailed review process, but it signals that editorial claims and health information are vetted by subject-matter advisors to ensure accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Republishing permission (free republication available)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site advertises that its stories may be republished for free (link provided). The page itself does not include the full terms or required attribution details — users must follow the linked "Republish our stories for free" page for specific requirements and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bilingual / Spanish-language availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Noticias en español — Find an array of American Heart Association News stories in Spanish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides Spanish-language content (a separate Spanish section) indicating an expectation to serve Spanish-speaking audiences and to offer translated or original Spanish stories. The page does not give translation standards or guidelines here.
